title: Si: Boltzmann transport with energy-dependent relaxation times
summary: Bulk silicon: the Boltzmann transport tensors in the constant relaxation-time approximation, the chemical potential of n-type Si at 1e19 electrons per cm^3 between 300 and 800 K, and its resistivity with acoustic-phonon and ionised-impurity relaxation times, one of them a custom TauModel.
